# Historical update frames

`56.json` records postcard payloads (without the four-byte big-endian frame
length) exchanged with the unmodified `0.1.3+local.0387aa2` daemon on fw16. The
private `/var/tmp/cr/s56-a` rehearsal used fake Codex providers, three native
chats and three terminals. One terminal wrote to a transcript, exercising the
old metadata layout. There were no windows, real providers or credentials.

The requests are Connect, List, ChatList, ResolveUpgradeChat, UpgradeImpact and
ShutdownV1 preflight. Resolve returns the source's real refusal because the live
chat has no durable replacement yet. It is a rejection fixture, not evidence
of successful lineage resolution. The capture tool and raw decoded inventories
are retained with the rehearsal evidence at
`/var/tmp/cagents-rehearsal/fw16-source56/` on fw16.

The corresponding `wire-formats/56.json` was generated by transplanting the
current `wire_shape.rs` tracer into a detached 0387aa2 checkout and tracing that
checkout's actual ClientEnvelope and ServerEnvelope types. The bespoke codec
shape test compares its entire reachable Impact, TerminalDescriptor and Session
graphs with that recording. Its chat adapter freezes the two source
NativeContinuity variants and refuses later retained-Claude descriptors. It does not admit protocol 56 as a general current
client or claim compatibility with its snapshots.
